behavior_contracts.A2.4/provenance: Every domain occurrence carries compiler-private provenance {boundary native|emitted, operation}. Compiler-owned request/config/credential validation, request encoding, bounded transport/body consumption and response decoding tag native with the executing fetch/judge/LLM declaration; AI question/answer validation, ordinary catalogue operations, authored construction and checks tag emitted. Classification for normalization and wrapper tables uses this pair, never the error name alone. Standard failures keep their channel; unknown native exceptions are never relabelled as domain errors.
behavior_contracts.A3.2/N-E-sets: Each native declaration records raw native obligations N and declared authored obligations E by exact error identity, tracked per set so one identity may belong to both. Fetch N is the mode-computed intrinsic set (auth-gated 1101, envelope-gated 1105, codec-gated 1110); judge N excludes AI validation (1120/1121 are E-only, preserved); question/arm/LLM hold N={} with E=declared since no normalization boundary consumes them. IR fetch/judge plans mirror both sets as checked evidence.

changes: runtime/failure.ts: new FailureProvenance {boundary, operation} plus freezeProvenance validation (emitted/empty default; native requires a non-empty operation; malformed tags throw).
runtime/domain.ts: DomainDetails gains provenance; create() takes an optional trailing provenance argument. All existing callers keep working with emitted/unattributed defaults.
runtime/transport/http.ts + named.ts: request() takes the producing operation; transport problems and request/response codec failures tag {native, operation}.

runtime/ai/typesafe.ts: ask() takes the judge operation; QuestionIssue/AnswerIssue tag {emitted, operation} (preserved AI validation), codec/byte-limit issues tag {native, operation}; transported through to the shared transport layer.
runtime/ai/responses.ts: generate() takes the LLM operation with the same emitted-validation/native-codec split; LLM keeps its separately specified raw bounds (no consumer yet).
compiler/internal/emit/fetch.go + judge.go + llm.go: lowered launches pass the declaration identity (plan/judge Identity) as the hidden operation argument after $canOrigin.

compiler/internal/check/native_program.go: checkNativeContracts splits the required intrinsic list into N (fetch: all required; judge: required minus 1120/1121; others: {}) and E (declared emits identities), sorted, stored on NativeDeclaration.
compiler/internal/ir/fetch.go + judge.go + check/native_bodies.go: IR plans carry Native/Emitted identity sets mirrored at IR construction (contracts run before bodies).
runtime/test call sites (transport-named, transport-http, typesafe-transport): all 33 request/ask invocations pass explicit test operation ids.

exit_mapping.integration: One-request judge preparation, whole-answer validation and ordered handlers exercised by the unchanged native suites inside the staged trio (all ok); fetch/LLM paths likewise green with the new hidden argument, including strict-tsc gates over all generated code. Authored/check failures retain emitted provenance (checks::failed asserts {emitted, ""}). Argument/descriptor evaluation lowers before $canFetch.request/$canAI.ask (emit shape tests), so pre-entry failures never enter the boundary. Nine private occurrence traces saved in LF09-traces.json as the LF10/LF12 input contract.
exit_mapping.negative: Unknown native exchange exceptions keep the standard channel as native_exception (exchange-throw test); decoder defects stay standard (existing transport-http test); codec/decode narrowing catches only CodecIssue/ResponseIssue/QuestionIssue/AnswerIssue and rethrow anything else (pinned by the standard-channel tests). Name-only classification is shown insufficient: native and authored codec::invalid_data share declaration and payload yet select different (boundary, name) keys. Malformed provenance and unattributed native tags throw TypeError. Pre-entry standard faults propagate without operation attribution (structural: evaluation precedes launch).
exit_mapping.positive: Native codec failure and authored codec::invalid_data with identical payloads are distinguished by provenance (runtime test + traces 2/3). Native transport failures carry (native, operation); judge AI validation carries (emitted, judge); judge state decoding carries (native, judge). N/E sets verified per mode: body-only fetch N=7, envelope N=5 with surplus in E, bytes N without codec, judge N=7 without AI validation, all mirrored to IR. Cause references and occurrence identity survive forwarding; equal reconstructions allocate fresh occurrences.

scope_note: Infrastructure only: no public error API, catalogue, or normalization behavior changes; AE07/AE09 remain open pending LF10/LF12. No Jev consultation was made: the user forbids paid live-provider calls, and LF09 presents no semantic fork (A2.4/A3.2 plus the task text fully determine the provenance pair and N/E split; representation choices are implementation detail a classifier cannot evaluate). Wrapper handler-phase attribution (never look up a handler's new error) is LF12 execution design and intentionally unsolved here; the (boundary, operation) pair plus arrival structure is the provided substrate. LLM transport tags native truthfully though LLM N={} since no normalization boundary consumes it.
